Selected projects

Case studies

Patient Experience Digital Platform

Digital transformation · Patient experience
Challenge
Patient experience activities and follow-up were spread across separate workflows, limiting visibility and coordination.
My role
Analyzed operational requirements, reviewed proposed features and workflows, coordinated with stakeholders and IT, and tracked development feedback and enhancements.
Deliverable
A structured digital framework for patient experience operations, with defined responsibilities and follow-up workflows.

Executive Operations Management Platform

Digital transformation · Executive operations
Challenge
Tasks, requests, approvals and follow-up were managed through different channels, making ownership and progress difficult to track.
My role
Contributed to the operating model and defined requirements for workflows, roles, permissions, notifications and reporting.
Deliverable
A centralized operating model designed to give executive leadership a clearer view of responsibilities and ongoing work.

Physician Document Submission & Verification Portal

Digital transformation · Process improvement
Challenge
Physician documentation required multiple review and approval steps involving different stakeholders.
My role
Helped define documentation requirements, workflow stages, permissions and approval paths.
Deliverable
A structured, traceable process for physician documentation and verification across a scope of 157 physicians.

HIS Enhancement & System Improvement

Health IT · Operational improvement
Challenge
Post-implementation system issues and enhancement requests needed consistent classification, prioritization and follow-up.
My role
Collected and analyzed system-related requests, identified operational gaps, prepared executive reports, and coordinated follow-up with IT.
Deliverable
A consolidated record of system issues and improvement requirements to support prioritization and track corrective actions.

Healthcare Operations & Performance Improvement

Operations · Performance improvement
Challenge
Operational data needed to be translated into clear findings and priorities for improvement.
